extra.final_summary: The data had three issues affecting the analysis: (1) one 'chinstrap' label in the 'species' column was lowercase and merged into 'Chinstrap' using normalize_labels; (2) one ' Torgersen' label in the 'island' column had a leading space and was merged into 'Torgersen'; (3) three rows with body_mass_g values over 3 million grams (far above the 6500g maximum) were excluded as likely data entry errors. After fixes, the average body mass for females is 3944.17 grams and for males is 4668.0 grams.
